definitions.gloss: smug look; self-satisfied expression; triumphant face
definitions.explanation: The look on someone's face when they are pleased with themselves for having been right or having pulled something off. Nearly always disapproving: the speaker finds the self-satisfaction irritating.

examples.japanese: ⟦{弟|おとうと}→弟：00572_otouto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧したり{顔|がお}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{笑|わら}った→笑う：00685_warau⟧。
「だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧でしょう」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧したり{顔|がお}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: "That's what I told you," she said with a smug look.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予想|よそう}→予想：03664_yosou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{当|あ}たった→当たる：01860_ataru⟧⟦からといって→からといって：30623_karatoitte⟧、⟦そんな→そんな：01645_sonna⟧したり{顔|がお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{腹|はら}が{立|た}つ→腹が立つ：06886_haragatatsu⟧。
examples.english: It's annoying to be given that self-satisfied look just because his prediction turned out right.

notes:
From the classical したり (I've done it, well done) + ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧ (face), with rendaku giving がお.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- したり{顔|がお}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to say something smugly
- したり{顔|がお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to put on a smug expression
- したり{顔|がお}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{語|かた}る→語る：01930_kataru⟧: to hold forth with an air of self-satisfaction

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{得意|とくい}{顔|がお}→得意顔：30673_tokuigao⟧: proud face — pleased with oneself, but often affectionate rather than critical
- ⟦ドヤ{顔|がお}→ドヤ顔：06939_doyagao⟧: smug face — recent slang with the same meaning, casual and humorous
- {澄|す}まし{顔|がお}: prim, unruffled face — composed rather than triumphant
